subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Myth = Mithya : Decoding Hindu Mythology'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Devdutt Pattanaik.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the book** 'Myth = Mithya: Decoding Hindu Mythology'** is **Devdutt Pattanaik.** 
 
• Myth = Mithya: A Handbook Of Hindu Mythology is a guide to unravelling and understanding the many myths and legends and the symbolism of the Hindu religion.
 
• The book explains concepts like the **Pitr, Jiva, the Devas and the Asuras**.
